about: Every friction a reader meets on this site, structured: who, where, what they tried, what happened, what they expected, the evidence, who can fix it and whether it landed. Kept by sherpa@php.newsroom; see admin/sherpa/README.md. Synthetic readers are test instruments, not people: their findings are prompts, and each is re-checked on the current version before it is logged.

frictions.intended: Learn in seconds, between meetings, whether to worry
frictions.actual: Four blocks of site machinery come before the briefing: the masthead with Ask and Feedback, the 'New to this story?' banner, the 'Your reading' tracker with five buttons, and the RESEARCH band. The headline starts 649px down an 844px screen; the thirty-second answer is below the fold.
frictions.expected: The headline and the thirty-second answer on the first screen
evidence: synthetic board run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (top fail, high)
synthetic designer run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (top fail, high)
sherpa walk on v0.8.1: h1 top at 649px on briefings/board/, 631px on briefings/cto/ and briefings/pm/, 569px on claims/, 550px on the front page (390x844, mobile)
telemetry to v0.5.9: 107 of 275 events (39%) from phones
frictions.proposal: On phones, collapse 'Your reading' and the origin band into one line under the standfirst (or behind a 'Reading tools' toggle), and show the 'New to this story?' banner only on the front page and only once. Target: h1 inside the top 250px of the first screen.
frictions.trend: worse: the Ask and Feedback row of v0.8.0 added about 60px above the fold

frictions.intended: Know what to tell the board
frictions.actual: No board-ready paragraph anywhere on the CTO's path; the board briefing is a separate path
frictions.expected: A 'What to tell the board' box of four or five sentences under the thirty-second answer
evidence: synthetic cto run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (top fail, high)
sherpa check on v0.8.1: no briefing contains 'what to tell the board'
frictions.proposal: Add a 'What to tell the board' box to the CTO and CISO briefings, generated from the same claims as the board briefing so it cannot drift.

frictions.intended: Put a hard date on the plan and report progress to clients
frictions.actual: No deadline stated (not even that none was set) and no status template
frictions.expected: A 'Deadlines' line (who set one, who did not, CISA KEV status) and a copyable status table with a two-line stakeholder update
evidence: synthetic pm run 2026-10-22T1754Z on v0.4.3 (two top fails, high)
sherpa check on v0.8.1: 'deadline' does not appear in briefings/pm/
frictions.proposal: As the reader proposed. The status table could be a download from /stack/ once it holds a reader's systems.

frictions.intended: Prove a Docker image is patched
frictions.actual: The Docker Official Image row names no tags, versions, digests or rebuild date; the developer briefing says only to run php -v, which gives the wrong answer for distribution backports
frictions.expected: Fixed tags per variant with the rebuild date, and a verification step that works on backports
evidence: synthetic developer run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (three top fails, high)
synthetic cto run on v0.4.3 (top change)
sherpa check on v0.8.1: the Docker row is still 'Docker Official Image: php' with no tag; /stack/ now explains that a backport keeps its old version number, which answers half of it
frictions.proposal: Capture the Docker Official Images rebuild into the vault, add the tags to the row, and link the developer briefing to /stack/ for the backport check.

frictions.intended: Cite the site's grading to the CISO
frictions.actual: CONFIRMED is used for single-source items, against the site's own definition
frictions.expected: One grade per claim, applied by the published rule
evidence: synthetic security run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (top fail, high)
fact-check run 1 (22 October): 11 of 70 claims carry a status word stronger than their evidence
frictions.proposal: The fact-check desk already found the same thing; the reader-facing fix is to show the desk's grade beside the status word wherever a claim appears, until the status words are corrected.

frictions.intended: Read without worrying about being charged
frictions.actual: An unlabelled pound figure in the masthead changed from page to page and read as a charge
frictions.expected: A label ('Reading credit, free') or nothing until the reader opens the account
evidence: synthetic designer run 2026-10-22T1753Z on v0.4.3 (top fail, high)
sherpa walk on v0.8.1: no pound figure visible on the first screen with external requests blocked; to re-check with the meter loading

frictions.intended: Go on to the next useful page
frictions.actual: 176 sessions made 275 page events, 1.6 per session; 237 of 275 events have no referrer, 34 came from this site. Most readers land and leave.
frictions.expected: A clear next step at the foot of every page for the reader they said they were
evidence: data/telemetry-report.json as of 2026-10-22 (site versions up to v0.5.9); counts are untrusted claims, see F009
frictions.proposal: A 'Where next for you' block at the foot of every page, from the reader's chosen persona path (data/personas.json already holds the paths), falling back to the three most-read pages for a reader with no persona.

frictions.intended: Know whether the site got easier to use since the readers last read it
frictions.actual: The synthetic readers last ran on v0.4.3 (22 October, 17:53Z); the site is at v0.8.1. Their fifteen top changes became no board rows, and none has shipped. Telemetry was last drained at v0.5.9.
frictions.expected: A run after every release, and each top fail on the board with an owner
evidence: data/synthetic.json: every persona's latest run is 0.4.3, runs: 1
data/admin.json: no open row cites a synthetic finding
REALITY.md: synthetic.yml needs repository secrets that are not set
frictions.proposal: The editor sets the two secrets (or a session runs the readers by hand after each release); the Sherpa turns each run's top fails into friction-log entries and board rows.

frictions.actual: Six of the top forty paths in the telemetry report are not pages on this site (/storyboards/briefing-2026-10-22/, /fractal/, /fractal/ui/, /admin/agents/rounds/, /admin/agents/librarian/, /admin/agents/roles/): forged rows (the append token is public by design) or another site writing to the same lane
frictions.expected: Rows for paths this site does not serve are counted apart
evidence: data/telemetry-report.json by_path as of 2026-10-22
checked against the v0.8.1 tree
frictions.proposal: The drain counts unknown paths separately (against sitemap.xml) and says so on the telemetry page; security to look at whether it is another site or a forgery.
